correctness.rationale: Lemma verified line-by-line: relation sum c_j/(x_j-y)=0 with c_j in F forces nonzero P(T)=sum c_j prod_{l!=j}(x_l-T) of degree <=N-1 with P(y)=0, so N<=[F(y):F] implies F-independence (hence k-independence). Conditional corollary dim_F=dim_k=q under [F(y):F]>=q follows since |X|=q and hypothesis forces q<=n/m, hence q/n,mq/n<=1. Sequences A (m=1,n=p^2) and B (m=1,n=p) both satisfy m/n->0,q->infty,p->infty; maximal-degree y exist by finite-field primitive elements. Artifact span_delta.py re-run locally: GF(4) trace identity, full k/F ranks in uncapped rows, dependence certificate (1,2,2) in capped row all pass. No overclaim: sequence deltas labelled conditional on maximal-degree approximants; definability and trf.deg halves explicitly open.
